items.question: What do I need for a quote, and where is my VIN?
items.answer: Start with your vehicle’s year, make and model, your area and a short description of what you need. Your VIN is helpful if you have it: look on your registration or insurance documents, or at the lower driver-side windshield. You can also contact us without the VIN so we can work through the details together.

items.question: Which areas do you serve?
items.answer: We serve Gatineau (Hull, Aylmer, Buckingham and Masson-Angers), Cantley, Chelsea, L’Ange-Gardien, Val-des-Monts, La Pêche, Pontiac, Notre-Dame-de-la-Salette, Thurso, Mayo, Lochaber, Lochaber-Partie-Ouest, Denholm, Low, Saint-Sixte, Bowman, Mulgrave-et-Derry and Plaisance, depending on your address within roughly 50 km, in Quebec only. This also includes the villages of Perkins, Saint-Pierre-de-Wakefield, Poltimore, Wakefield, Sainte-Cécile-de-Masham, Lascelles, Duclos, Lac-des-Loups, Luskville and Quyon. For addresses near the boundary, including Val-des-Bois, send your city or postal code so we can confirm travel and arrange your appointment with you.

items.question: How much does replacement cost?
items.answer: The quote is free. We prepare it for your vehicle and the windshield it needs, and confirm the work and price with you before you agree to go ahead. There’s no extra charge for mobile service.

items.question: Is my replacement covered by a warranty?
items.answer: Yes. We explain what’s covered when we send your quote.

items.question: How fast will I hear back, and does my request book an appointment?
items.answer: We reply within 24 hours of your request. It simply starts the conversation: you confirm your appointment once we’ve agreed on the work, the location and the time.

items.question: My vehicle has a camera. What about calibration?
items.answer: Tell us about any cameras or driver assistance features so we can work through those needs with you. If ADAS calibration is required, we’ll refer you to an appropriate provider and help clarify that step before confirming the replacement.

items.question: Do you offer repair or replacement?
items.answer: Our service is windshield replacement. If you’re unsure whether you need repair or replacement, start by describing the damage and your vehicle: we’ll help you understand the next step before agreeing on the work.

items.question: Can I contact you about a business vehicle?
items.answer: Yes, you’re welcome to contact us about a business vehicle. Share the number and type of vehicles and their location so we can discuss your needs and confirm together whether we can take on the work.

items.question: Can my insurance cover the replacement?
items.answer: Your insurer can confirm the coverage and deductible under your policy. We can prepare a quote for your claim so you can check with them what amount, if any, you would need to pay.
